critique: The pink soft-focus glow and black background are directionally appropriate, but both t1 and t4 show only one large centered blob. There is no visible multi-blob field, variation, spatial spread, or appreciable motion between frames, so it does not yet resemble a Light Blobs preset thumbnail or animation.

suggestions.why: Raise the main emission rate so multiple distinct blobs are present rather than a single isolated particle.
Widen the X emission region to distribute blobs across the frame instead of stacking at the center.
Widen the Y emission region to form a loose luminous cluster rather than a centered overlap.
Keep blob movement gentle and drifting after widening the emitter, avoiding the prior explosive radial motion.
Extend particle persistence so the distributed blob field can accumulate and remain visible over time.
